what: Misread: Sri's 'Dunno if Athena knows that literally everything of it's design can be changed' was read as a docs-only change (a README sentence for engineers), with prompts, rules and code out of scope. Sri's point is that Athena itself, its roles and agents, should know and act on it. The real blocker is the ladder rule in docs/design/roles-and-ladder.md: roles may change only the lowest two rungs and design decisions go to a person, so the steward cannot change design even when it should.
why: Reported so Athena learns how Sri means 'Athena knows': its working rules and roles, not documentation for human readers. Not re-queued by hand.
